finding: The terminal actor list had no per-actor position proof, so a later STOP elsewhere could qualify for formation recall.
implementation: Five-field public receipt appends bounded netId/ATL position rows recorded only at actual terminal doStop. New-order handback and shutdown require shared same-floor hold observation; deferred actors retain their original positions. Locality adoption validates and filters rows without movement replay. All current receipt writers/readers use the new shape.
limits: No improvement to physical entry coherence or security-post selection is claimed.
